tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (cha)༄༅/ /gsung lan dogs pa'i rnyog ma bgrung ba'i nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer rnon po'i mdzub rtse yis/ /bdag blo'i gong
(cha)༄༅/ /gsung lan dogs pa'i rnyog ma bgrung ba'i nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer rnon po'i mdzub rtse yis/ /bdag blo'i gong

tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// gsung lan dogs pa'i rnyog ma bgrung ba'i nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs// mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer rnon po'i mdzub rtse yis// bdag blo'i gong bu'i 'phang 'gror bsnun tsam gyis// legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i mgrin glu'i dbyangs 'jo ba'i// bla ma tshangs sras nyi mas dge legs stsol// rnam dag bslab gzhis sgo gsum bag yod sdom// rnam mang gzhung lugs thos bsam bsgom pas sbyangs// rnam dpyod blo gros ngag dbang lhas byin pa// rnam mkhyen thub pa'i sras gyur dge ba'i bshes// gang blo ma la ya yi nags khrod nas// dogs pa'i dri khyer gyis bskyod dri ba'i bsung*// chos smra'i yid kyi 'dron pas 'thungs las skyes// gsung lan ngal gso'i rgyang glu 'di skad mol// de'ang sdom gsum 'chang ba'i bshes gnyen mkhar mdo'i dbu mdzad ngag dbang bsod nams pas dogs gnas kyi dri tshig tu/ 'di phyogs su sa dbang chen po'i sku rim du phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i cho ga sogs 'di skor dgos che ba mchis par/ 'di'i brgyud 'debs mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad par/ phyag rdor nas dī paṃ ka ra la thug pa 'dra zhig mchis shing*/ cho ga'i mjug tu bkod pa'i brgyud par de'i bar la rab gsal zla ba sogs rgya paṇa bdun tsam byung ba cig shos la chad pa yin nam ma nges pa dang*/ de'i brgyud pa'i mthar gsol 'debs kyi tshig med par gsol ba btab pa'i dge ba bsngo ba zhig byung ba yi ge ma dag pa'am ci yin gsungs pa/ lan ni/ 'di 'dra'i rigs la bdag cag gi ston pas/ bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du// legs par brtags la nga yi bka'// blang bar bya yi gus phyir min// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ston pa nyid kyi bka' la'ang brtag byar gnang ba ltar/ 'di la'ang rgyu mtshan 'di ltar thos te mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid la/ dngos slob ldan ma dbang bla kun dga' bstan 'dzin pas 'di'i brgyud 'debs dgos zhus pa na/

sang nyin dpon slob gnyis ka thugs brel yong ba'i rgyus/ de'i nub mor mar me'i 'od du zhu ngo ma ldog tsam bris nas rtsom gdan shog tshar bcad 'phral du gnang byung ba'i gsung sgros mchis pa ltar/ don la'ang de bzhin snang ste/ bka' rtsom gnang nas/ slar yang zhib dpyad kyi gzigs pas ma khyab pa'i rjes mngon sum lus pa dang*/ gsan yig sogs la gzigs skabs ma byung bas/ bla ma 'ga' zhig chad pa dang gsol 'debs kyi tshig kyang gsal ma thub pas go ste/ de lta min na rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyi gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por brgyud pa tshang ma bris 'dug pas kyang shes par nus so// gzhan du 'di rigs la nye brgyud yod srid kyang*/ 'di la ni de 'dra yod pa gsan yig brgyud rim mang po nas kyang ma byung bas/ brgyud rim bla ma 'di rnams kha bskang dgos nges te/ de'ang 'di ltar thub pa'i dbang po phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po/ pradzñā pā li ta/ pradzhā boddhiḥ mukti ko ṣa/ dharma pā la/ de nas dī paṃ ka ra 'byung dgos pa dang*/ mjug gi kha skong kho bos thob brgyud ltar byas pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad bcas logs su zhus chen gyi tshul du bris nas phul yod pas der gzigs pas khyab/ yang sgrol dkar gyi cho ga dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i bdag bskyed kyi skabs nas rigs bdag rgyas gdab kyi rjes su gong tshogs zhing skabs ltar mchod par gsungs pa la sngar gyi zhal khrid du ngos bzung nas thams cad kyi 'gor mtshan sngags sbyar ba dharma ra ṇi rol chen bcas pa dar zhes sogs 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba dang*/ bum pa'i skabs nas bum pa'i nang gi lha zhu ba las chu bdud rtsir gyur zhes pa la'ang*/ dam ye phye dgos min la mi mnyam pa dang*/ mdun bskyed brtan byed kyi bzlas pa'i mjug tu mchod bstod bsdus pa ji ltar bgyi ba'i gsal kha dgos gsungs pa/

lan ni sgrol dkar gyi sgrub thabs yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis bskyed pa'i rjes thogs mchod pa la gong ltar gsungs pa 'di la gzhan gyi 'gros sbyar na/ oṃ arya tā rā yai sa pa ri wā ra lta bu zhig gis chog pa ltar snang yang*/ yig cha 'di rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi bzhed pa/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen pas mdzad pa'i yi ge der yang*/ tā re sarba buddha boddhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra zhes sbyar ba/ bod skad du/ sgrol ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa zhes pa'i don du 'gyur ba de ltar tshogs zhing gi skabs su yod pa dang*/ bzlas pa'i gong gi la'ang gong ltar zhes gsungs pa/ de ltar du rje dkon mchog lhun grub pas kyang de nyid ji lta ba gzhir bzhag mdzad pa ni/ gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ltar mchis pas de bzhin bya ba legs te/ rgyu mtshan yi dam gyi lha gcig la sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs nas bstims pas kyang de ltar brjod pas mi 'gal ba dang*/ der ma zad yi dam gyi lha gcig la yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems kun 'dus su bsgom pa ni gsang sngags pa'i zab gnad che ba ste/ yi dam spyi'i bstod pa la'ang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid// sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces 'byung ba'i phyir/ des na mchod pa de la mtshan sngags nyer spyod re re'i 'gor sngon du 'gro ba mi dgos te/ gong gi tshogs zhing la mtshan sngags lan gcig sngon 'gro las ma bshad pa'i phyir/ lhag par rol chen sogs dngos bsham gyi mchod pa mi dgos te/ bdag bskyed skabs kyi mchod pa phal cher la spros pa chen po mi byed par/ ting nge 'dzin gtso che ba la dgongs pa'i phyir/ bdag gi rnal 'byor la dngos bsham gyi mchod 'bul gtan nas 'gog tu'ang ci zhig yod de/

ji skad du/ bdag nyid lha ru bskyed pa la// mchod na bsod nams brnyas na sdig /ces gsungs pa dang mthun pa ste/ kun rig sogs kyi skabs ltar ro// des na bzlas pa'i gong 'og gi mchod pa 'di dag la mtshan sngags lan gcig sngon du 'gro ba nyid du gzung ngo*// de dag la sngar gyi zhal khrid dam phyag len yin zhes pa rnams la brtag byar yod pa'ang mchis te/ 'thad mi 'thad sna tshogs snang ba'i phyir/ de'i bum pa bsgrubs pa'i skabs kyi bum pa'i lha ye shes pa gshegs gsol dgos pa gor ma chag ste/ rnal 'byor rgyud man chad kyi rgyud sde'i spyi lugs shes pa'i dbang du btang ba yin pa ma gtogs mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan min 'gro/ gal te gshegs gsol ma dgos na/ mjug rdul tshon gshegs gsol gyi skabs/ bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs gsol brjod los dgos mod/ de ni rgyud sde'i bab dang yang mi 'grigs pas so// des na mchod yon gshegs skyems kyi tshul du phul bas/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur ces brjod pa nyid legs so// mdun bskyed bzlas pa'i rjes kyi mchod pa la mtshan sngags nyer spyod kun gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i sngags mchod tsam dang*/ dharma ra ṇi bcas dang*/ bstod pa 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod pa rnams bya ba yin no// yang gser mdog pa nor bzang bkra shis dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i dgongs gsol skabs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan phreng du bde ba'i rdo rje'i rjes su/ pradzñā ka ra warma zhes snang ba de shraddhā ka ra warma zhes pa yin pa 'dra zhes smras kyang la las sngar gyi yi ge dag pa 'ga' la'ang mchis zhes gleng 'dug pa gang yin gsungs pa lan ni/ paṇa chen bde ba'i rdo rje'i rjes thogs su byung ba sogs kyis dad byed go cha nyid yin dgos mod yi ge bris nor yin las che'i/

shes rab 'byung gnas go cha'i skad dod mi 'dra snyam ste/ de ni khyad par 'phags bstod kyi 'grel pa sogs byed mkhan de'o// yang 'jigs byed las bzhi'i sbyin sreg tu 'das pa'i me lha bskyed skabs/ 'phags pa'i gsung rab dang dkon lhun dang nam mkha' dpal bzang sogs kyis mdzad pa'i yig char dbang lha ye shes pa'i tshul du bstim pa'i bar tsam las ma byung yang*/ 'ga' zhig sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa hrīḥṣṭ+rī lan gsum brjod pa bcas dgos gsungs pa gang yin gsung bris gnang zhes gsungs pa/ lan ni/ mchog sgrub pa'i bdag mdun la ni sems dpa' sum brtsegs dang sngags rgya'i byin rlabs bcas nges par dgos la/ sbyin sreg 'das pa'i me lha la dbang gi lha ye shes pa'i tshul du bstim pa'i bar gyis lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis bskyed zin pas las rgyas sgrub pa la de tsam gyis chog par/ rwa lo sogs kyi yi ger yang ye shes pa dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas zhes pa tsam las/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs sogs bsgom pa dngos su ma bshad pa'i phyir ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med la/ 'on te ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis 'jigs byed gtor ma'i las kyi skabs nas mdun bskyed la hrīḥṣṭ+rīḥs gnas gsum bsrung ba'i bar byas nas zhes 'byung ba dang 'dra ba'i 'gros kyis/ da ltar phal cher gyis sbyar gyin 'dug pa'ang*/ rgyas pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba las gzhan du mi 'gyur ram snyam ste/ snga ma ltar na chad skyon mi 'byung bar yid ches lung gis grub pa'i phyir dang*/ phyi ma ltar yang ma 'brel ba'i lhag skyon mi 'gyur bar rigs pas 'grub pa'i phyir 'gal med som nyis dben pa nyid du rtogs par bya'o// de dag gis ni gsung lan nyung ngu'i don cung zad smreng zin to// smras pa/ rnyog pa'i rdzing bur ke ta kas bsnun pas// gzugs brgya snang ba'i rang bzhin bgrungs pa ltar// chos la 'phyang mo nyug gis bslad pa'i gnad// dpyad gsum gtam gyis nges par gtan la phab// 'dir 'bad dge ba'i skyes sbyangs blo gros kyis// som nyi'i sgrib pa spangs pa'i pha rol nas// gtsug lag rig pa'i gnas lugs yongs rig ste// 'gro la 'doms pa'i rgyal po nyid gyur cig

/ces rnam par dpyod ldan mkhar mdo dbu mdzad pa'i gsung lan dogs pa'i rnyog bgrung nor bu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa'i legs gsungs bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i bande/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde'am/ tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pas rab byung 'dod pa'i sna tshogs zhes pa'i gnam lo'i zla

5 tshes 11 la lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris te phul ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig// / ༄༅// nyams su blang byar gdams pa'i bdud rtsi gsol 'debs snye ma bsu ba'i dbyar gyi dpal mor bcas bzhugs// ༄༅// phun tshogs mkhyen brtse nus pa'i kun phan zer// sing dkyil sa mos tshal du lhung ba'i 'phral// lung rtogs 'dab stong 'grol ba'i 'khor lo'i mgon// skyabs mchog bla ma rnams kyis gnang ba stsol// 'dzam bu'i gling mchog legs bris rdzing bu'i nang*// dal rten chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad ldan gyis// dge chos nyi 'od 'thung la spro ba can// skyabs gsum sdom pa'i ge sar 'dzin ma des// rtag par bag yod dran shes byar rung ba'i// lam gyi rim pa'i zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i thigs// de tshul rgyud la skye ba'i gsol 'debs bcas// yi ger stsol zhes lan du 'di skad gleng*// dge sbyor gang byed thog mar 'di ltar bsam// skyabs mchog de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas// mkha' khyab bzhugs nas 'gro ba'i legs nyes tshogs// gsal ler mkhyen gyin yod snyam dad mos bya// 'khor ba'i skye gnas gang du skyes gyur kyang*// sdug bsngal 'gyur dang 'du byed sdug bsngal gyi// rgyun chad med par nyen pa'i 'khor ba yi// phun tshogs snying po med las yid 'byung bskyed// de las thar pa'i lam mchog sgrub pa'i rten// mi lus yin mod de ni yang nas yang*// thob par dka' bas da lta'i tshe mjug 'dir// sdig spong dge ba sgrub pa gal che ste// sdig pa mi dges ngan song sdug bsngal bskyed// mtho ris na yang bde med sdug bsngal mang*// de spangs dge ba'i las kyis skye ba kun// bde ba thob phyir ci nus bsgrub sems bskyed// de bzhin 'khor ba'i las ni 'di phyi kun// sdug bsngal du ma'i 'byung gnas shes byas nas// tshe 'dir chags zhen chung ba'i blo skyes na// dge sbyor gang byed lam du 'gro ba yin// da dung sems can rnams la byams snying rje// byang chub sems sogs bsgom rgyu mang yod kyang*// nyams len gtso bo nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i// skabs su rgyas par 'byung phyir 'dir ma spros// lam de'i skyabs yul bla ma rdo rje chos// bla ma dkon mchog gsum 'dus shes byas nas// rang dang pha

bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs/ mas thog drangs sems can rnams// byang chub bar du skyabs su 'gro snyam bya// tshe rabs sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho sogs/ pha mar gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sdug bsngal las brgal sangs rgyas sar bkri phyir// rnal 'byor ma yi lam 'di bsgom snyam du// byang chub sems bskyed yin phyir nan tan bya// de rjes sdig rang gi spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i sogs/ sbyong rdor sems shes na bsgom// byin rlabs 'byung gnas bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni// mdun mkhar mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri sogs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos// gcig pu nyid la skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum// ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yin bsams nas// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs/ gsol ba btab nas rang la thim par bsam// bla ma rang sems dbyer med 'dres pa'i ngang*// rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug dbyer med bzhi// bla ma sku bzhi zung 'jug bdag nyid du// gdod nas gnas pa'i rang zhal ma bcos ltos// rang gi snying ga'i sngags phreng rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs sogs/ 'od zer gyis// rang lus sbyangs nas rnal 'byor mar bsgyur zhing*// lte bar oṃ baṃ sogs kyis go cha bcings// gzhan lus thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros sogs/ sbyangs nas bsgyur ba'ang dkyus bzhin bya// baṃ phaiṃ thugs ka'i baṃ yig las 'od zer sogs/ las 'od 'phros dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs// spyan drangs rang la bstim nas nga rgyal bya// de nas bdag ni rnal 'byor ma yi sku// snang stong cung zad sems gtad bskyed rim yin// gsang sngags zab mo ngag bzlas thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros sogs/

yid bzlas dang*// bsam mi khyab lte ba'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud sogs/ pa'i rnal 'byor nā da yang*// mi dmigs btang snyoms skyong lugs gong dang 'dra// spyod lam rang dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rje btsun ma'i sku sogs/ nyal ldang la sogs dkyus ltar bya// mdor na rgyun du nyams len snying po ni// bzlas pa'i skabs dang spyod lam thams cad du// rang dang grogs sogs mig tu gang snang ba// me long nang gi gzugs ltar rnal 'byor ma// snang ba'i rang bzhin dpyad ngor stong pa nyid// zung 'jug lha sku sgyu ma chen por blta// rna bar thos pa'i bzang ngan sgra thams cad// oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang ba sngags kyi sgra// rang bzhin dpyad na grag stong dbyer med pa// brag ca'i sgra dbyangs lta bu'i ngang du skyong*// sems kyi dran rtog bzang ngan ji snyed pa// rig tsam rang gi ngo bos stong pa nyid// rig stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi// gnas lugs rang zhal dag pa'i ngang du skyong*// lha sngags ye shes gsum gyi 'khyer so 'di// bde dang sdug bsngal na 'chi bar do yi// gnas skabs kun du ma brjed dran byas na// don chen 'grub par 'gyur ro chos 'dzin ma// zab mo don gyi snying po yongs bsdus pa'i// nyams su blang byar gdams pa'i bdud rtsi yin// slar yang de dag rgyud la skye ba'i yul// mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di ltar brjod// //sarbārtha siddhirbha ba tu/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i phyogs mthar yongs khyab par// rtsa brgyud bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems// dpag yas sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa ltar// bdag cag bsam pa mkhyen bzhin bzhugs par bsam// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba dang*// rgyal sras rang rgyal thos sgrogs bcas pa la// bdag dang 'gro ba kun gyis phyag 'tshal zhing*// skyabs su mchi'o gsol gdab don yod mdzod// mi lus thob nas dam chos dang mjal ba// bskal pa brgya lam na yang rnyed dka' la// rnyed pa'i lus kyang nam 'chi nges med phyir// mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs// slad mar mi dge'i las kyis ngan song gsum// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzad myong 'gyur zhing*// dge ba'i las las bde legs 'byung shes nas// sdig spong dge la brtson par byin gyis rlobs// dkon mchog skyabs song de yi bslab bya la// lhur len la sogs dge sbyor gang byed kyang*// rang nyid bde rgyur dmigs la ma chags par// theg chen lam du 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// sems can thams cad tshe rabs pha mar shes// de yi drin gzor bde 'dod byams pa dang*// ngan song 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsal 'dod kyi// tshad med snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs// theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba byang chub sems// bdag gzhan bde 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod mnyam// bdag gi bde dang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag

/brje ba'i sems mchog bsgom par byin gyis rlobs// rnam par rtog bral rtse gcig sems gnas par// gsal snang khyad par can gyi zhi gnas dang*// chos kun bdag med rtogs pa'i lhag mthong gis// bdag 'dzin nyon mongs zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// sbyin sogs pha rol phyin drug spyod gru yis// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i mthar son rdzogs sangs rgyas// yon tan nor bu'i gter chen mngon gyur nas// skye dgu'i 'dod pa'i re skong nyid byin rlobs// khyad par tshe gcig mngon par 'tshang rgya'i thabs// rnal 'byor bla med nye lam bsgom pa yi// sngon 'gro tshogs bsags dngos gzhi bskyed rdzogs kyi// rnal 'byor bsgom pa gegs med nyid byin rlobs// rang gzhan snang ba'i dngos po lha yi sku// me long nang gi gzugs ltar snang ba yi// rang bzhin stong pa dbyer med bsgoms pa'i mthus// sprul skus gzhan don 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs// rang gzhan brjod dang grag pa sgra yi tshogs// yi dam sngags kyi sgra ste grag stong dag /dbyer med brag ca'i sgra dbyangs shes pa'i mthus// chos sgra 'gag med 'byin par byin gyis rlobs// sems kyi dran rtog 'gyu ba bltas pa na// rig tsam gshis lugs skye 'gag gnas pas stong*// rig stong gnyis su med pa'i rgyun bskyangs pas// ye shes lnga mdangs gsal bar byin gyis rlobs// sbyang gzhi 'khor ba'i chos su kun rtog pa// sbyong byed lha yi 'khor lor bsgoms pa'i mthus// sbyangs 'bras 'khor 'das mtha' la mi gnas pa'i// zung 'jug sku bzhi'i dbang phyug bdag byin rlobs// de srid skye bar dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i rten// bla ma lhag pa'i lha dang mi 'bral bar// rjes gzung lung rtogs chos la dbang 'byor zhing*// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// tshul 'dis gsol btab sa bon ma rmas pas// dge legs myu gu dar babs bskyed bsring rtser// mngon 'dod snye ma bslu med g.yur za ba// yul bsam smon lam dag pa'i rten 'brel mthu// bka' srol dngos brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs dang*// dngos grub 'dzad med yi dam thugs rje che// bstan srung mthu rtsal rmad byung bden pa'i mthus// gsol btab 'bras bu myur du smin par shog

/ces pa ngag gis brjod do 'di nyid ni// mkha' la spyod dang thugs rje chen po sogs// mdo sngags zung 'brel bla med lam gyi tshul// kun gyi gsol gdab 'don byar btub par bgyis// 'dir smras pa/ deng 'dir thun mong thun mong min pa'i lam// sgrub thabs rnal 'byor brjod pa dkyus bstan tsam// de min gzhung don brjod bya'i snying po'i bcud// med thabs med pa'i gnad 'gag btus 'di ko /don gnyer nyams blang gdams pa'i a mṛ ta// gsol 'debs snye ma bsu ba'i dbyar gyi dpal// bris pa'i dge bas mdo sngags theg pa kun// 'gro la 'doms pa'i nyi ma nyid gyur cig /ces nyams su blang byar gdams pa'i bdud rtsi gsol 'debs snye ma bsu ba'i dbyar gyi dpal mor bcas pa 'di ni/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba'i bod phyogs chos 'dzin ma can gyi ngor/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i ring lugs kyi rjes su slob pa'i bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i nyi ma zhes pa'i gnam lo gsar tshes su lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// dge tshogs byang chub snying po'i rgyur smin pa'i bsngo ba smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa'i byang chub spyod pa'i gser 'gyur zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// sarbārtha siddhirbha wa tu/ phyogs bcu'i zhing gi mi mchog chos rnga che// de sras gdung 'tshob thos sgrogs srung mar bcas// dge ba yongs bsngo sgyu ma'i rtse 'jo'i klong*// smon lam grub pa'i bden dpang dgongs shig kye// rang bzhin spros bral chos sku kun du bzang*// dge mtshan rdzogs pa'i longs sku gsang ba'i bdag /'gro 'dul thabs mkhas sprul sku padma 'byung*// rnam gsum dbyer med nges pa'i thal sbyar 'ching*// mkha' yi rna ba gcig las dag byed snod// ji snyed grangs su gzugs brnyan ston pa bzhin// ston pa mchog dang zhu 'dri tha dad kyi// ngo mtshar bkod pa legs bstan gsungs pa'i chos// gsung rab kun gyi yang rtse rgyud sde yi// rjes 'brang gzhi lam 'bras bus bsdus pa'i chos// kun gyi bslab byar slob pa'i phyogs kun las// rnam par 'gal ba'i nongs pa gang dag yod// yon tan zhing gyur phyi nang gsang ba yi// dpal ldan bla ma yi dam zhi dang khro// rgyal ba sras slob mkha' 'gro chos srung bcas// kun gsal 'gram par gtams pa'i g.yar lam du// sngags lam gzhi ma rtsa ba yan lag dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams so cog

/snying gi dkyil nas 'gyod kyin mthol bshags kyi// dri med dag byed bshags pa'i rgyud chen 'di// gang dag klog 'dzin yid la byed pa'i rgyud// tshe rabs bsags pa'i sdig ltung nyes tshogs bcas// skad cig nyid nas sprin bral zla ba yi// dkyil 'khor ji bzhin yang dag yon tan ston// thun mong 'gro ngor gsungs pa thar pa che// phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo sogs mang bstan las// thun mong min pa'i gdul byar gsang rgyud kyis// nyer bstan bshags pa'i rgyud nyid khyad par 'phags// tshul chen sngo bsangs bai ḍūrya yi gzhir// rin chen khams kyis rnam bkra'i rgyu sbyor mkhan// dad gsum yid kyi shing rta chos spyod bcu'i// phyogs su drangs la klu skyid ces byas bzhengs// 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge bas sbyin pa'i bdag /ltos bcas kyis mtshon mar gyur sems can rnams// ngan 'gro srid pa'i sdug bsngal de rgyur bcas// byang dag 'bras bu dal 'byor lus thob shog /dad pa'i zhing sa gshin par dkon mchog gsum// skyabs song sdom pa'i sa bon gang btab pa// bag yod spyod pa'i mthun rkyen legs sbyar bas// 'di phyir bde ba'i log thog legs gyur cig /khyad par tshe gcig 'tshang rgya bgyid pa'i thabs// gsang chen lam ston rdo rje slob dpon mjal// des bstan zhi khro rab 'byams lhag pa'i lha// bka' srung dam can mi 'bral 'grogs par shog /rim can cig car thob pa sdom pa'i tshogs// nyes med bsrung zhing bag med 'gal byas tshe// nyes ltung lhan cig mi 'grogs 'gyod sems kyis// mthol tshangs dag pa'i dam tshig la gnas shog /gzhan don bla med byang chub 'dod pa'i blos// chos kun spros bral lta bas rgyud sbyangs nas// bskyed rdzogs rnal 'byor bsgom brtson sngags spyod kyis// mtha' yas yon tan rgyud la bskyed par shog /sngags spyod nus pa grub pa'i gom rlabs kyis// dpag yas tshogs gnyis nor 'dzin yongs gzhal la// bar chad stobs ldan rkang 'og bcing ba dang*// yon tan mi zad khyab 'jug stobs rdzogs shog

/mthar thug che mchog yan lag bdun ldan gnas// mngon gyur sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum// bsam gyis mi khyab lhun grub yon tan gyis// srid pa nam gnas gzhan don 'byung bar shog /de srid skye bar rigs bzang blo gros gsal// lnga rig mkhas dang grub pas rjes bzung nas// mdo sngags gdams pa thar pa mchog gi gsos// btung bas 'tsho ba'i skal ba can gyur cig /byin rlabs 'dzad med dngos grub ci 'dod 'jo// gang bcol phrin las thogs med sgrub byed par// ches cher bsngags pa'i bla ma lha srung tshogs// bden pa'i stobs kyis smras don 'grub gyur cig /yid bzang dbang po mi bdag ltos 'phye sogs// 'jig rten cher rlom kun gyis mchod byas pa'i// bsod nams phung po mtha' klas thob gyur pa// mchog gsum bkra shis des 'dir bde legs shog /ces rin chen khams las grub pa'i dri med bshags rgyud dad rten du bzhengs pa'i dge tshogs byang chub snying po'i rgyur smin pa'i bsngo ba smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa byang chub spyod pa'i gser 'gyur zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dad gsum snying gi nor ldan sbyin pa'i bdag mo klu skyid ma'i ngor/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po brgyud par bcas pa'i legs gsungs bdud rtsi'i btung bas 'tsho ba'i bande tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pas/ lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /gang mtshan 'dzin cing gsol ba btab tsam gyis// snyigs ma'i lus can mi bzad duḥkha las// gdon byed thugs rje'i skyabs sbyin phyag brkyangs nas// ci 'dod re skong grub dbang brtson 'grus bzang*// gang skur dngos grub thugs rje che ba'i lhas// yongs su bskor ba'i gzugs brnyan brgya byin tshon// mtshungs las phan yon 'byin pa'i khyad par can// sbyin bdag a zlos bzhengs pa'i dge ba yis// bar chad mi mthun rgud pa kun zhi zhing*// tshe dpal bsod nams chu gter rgyas pa'i klong*// tshogs gnyis sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan ches rgyas shog

/sku gzugs kyi zhal byang smon lam gsol ba nyung ngu 'di'ang*/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// ༈ /oṃ swasti pra dza bhyaḥ gang 'dul thabs kyi gru chen la zhugs nas// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor byings pa'i sems can rnams// gdon byed thugs rje'i ded dpon bla na med// bcu gcig zhal mnga'i gangs can mgon po la// dge slong dpal mo zla ba gzhon nu dang*// rigs lnga'i rgyal bas bskor ba'i sku brnyan 'di// gnyer pa a zlos zhes byas phyag mchod dang*// bsod nams rten du mthun rkyen sbyar nas bskrun// dge tshogs skye ba 'di nas byang chub bar// mi khom brgyad spongs dal 'byor lus thob cing*// bla ma lha mchog thugs rje che ldan gyis// rjes bzung lung rtogs chos la spyod phyir bsngo// zhes zhal byang smon lam nyung ngu 'di'ang bande tshul rin gyis so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
